tools.name: get_certificate_verification_info
tools.description: Explain how an employer can verify a confined-space.com certificate of completion, and where to do it.

tools.name: get_price_quote
tools.description: Calculate the price for a number of seats in one confined-space.com course, including the automatic bulk seat discount.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List all training courses offered on confined-space.com with length, price per seat, audience, topics covered, and page URL.

tools.name: recommend_course
tools.description: Recommend the right confined space course for a person based on what they do on the job. Use this when someone asks which course they need.

role.description: works_near = works near confined spaces but never enters; entrant = physically enters permit spaces; attendant = stays outside monitoring the entrant; entry_supervisor = authorizes/cancels entry permits; program_manager = oversees the confined space program (safety manager, EHS, competent person).

tools.name: search_site_content
tools.description: Search confined-space.com content (FAQ answers, course curriculum, credential details, employer responsibilities, policies) and return the most relevant sections.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "atmospheric testing" or "refund policy".

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Open the confined-space.com checkout page with a course and seat count selected. The person must enter their own billing and card details and click Pay; this tool never submits a payment.
